Looking at panel A (TBI, CTX = cerebral cortex), the bar graph of fold increase in Ac‑tau/tau across salsalate doses shows that the pathological elevation seen in TBI + Vehicle is progressively reduced as the dose increases, with the greatest reduction (closest to sham levels) occurring at the highest tested dose, 25 mg/kg. This is also the dose selected for the behavioral treatment regimen (panel E). Therefore salsalate reaches its maximal effect in the cerebral cortex at 25 mg/kg.

[ANSWER]D[/ANSWER]
